{
  "body_plan": "A pear-shaped plush character has a continuous tan body, blue arms, a face on its upper front, and long curly hair covering its back.",

  "missing_human_parts": ["legs", "feet", "distinct neck", "separate head", "distinct hips"],
  "bone_regions": {
    "root": "base of the body and overall position",

    "top": "crown and upper hair",
    "arm_L": "left blue arm and hand",
    "arm_R": "right blue arm and hand"
  },
  "substitutions": {
    "arms": "Use the blue arms to gesture, swing, and reach.",
    "legs": "Suggest steps with small hops, side-to-side shifts, and body bounces.",
    "hips": "Use lower-body sway and twist to suggest hip movement.",
    "head": "Use gentle upper-spine and top-bone turns to orient the face.",
    "torso": "Bend and twist the spine to make the whole plush body groove."
  },
  "constraints": [
    "Keep the body from sinking into the floor.",
    "Do not imply separate knees, feet, or a detached head.",

    "Keep arm rotations within the rig limits."
  ]
